facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: TechCabal states Kenya's Data Protection Act caps penalties for breaches at KES 5 million or 1% of annual turnover, whichever is lower.
The Office of the Data Protection Commissioner is investigating Meta and two Sama companies, confirmed on 31 March 2026 per TechCabal.
The ODPC confirmed on 31 March 2026 an open investigation into Meta and two Sama companies over Ray-Ban glasses footage, with no decision yet reported.
TechCabal says the ODPC imposed the full $38,000 penalty on smartphone maker OPPO in 2022, its first penalty notice.
